video_read: The video follows Gaspar's challenge to launch a profitable dropshipping business with only one euro in 24 hours. He explains his preference for Google Ads due to better margins and long-term potential, despite the initial 100-euro requirement. He earns this money by cleaning a car and walking a dog, then sets up a Shopify store and Google Ads campaign for a GPS watch for children. The strongest moments are when he reveals the profit made (539.6s) and attributes his success to knowledge and coaching (564.4s), which directly serves the campaign's goal of selling a business training program.
